scenes.name: default
state: set 3 -1 text "To whom it may concern,"
set 5 -1 text "The shipment of ore has been delayed"
set 6 -1 text "by the storms off the Feldip coast."
set 7 -1 text "Expect it no sooner than the equinox."
set 9 -1 text "Burn this once you have read it."

scenes.name: default
state: set 4 -1 text "Here lies the record of the old kingdom,"
set 5 -1 text "set down by the hand of its last scribe."
set 6 -1 text "Three kings ruled from the western hall."
set 7 -1 text "The first built the walls."
set 8 -1 text "The second built the mines beneath them."
set 9 -1 text "The third built nothing, and lost both."
set 10 -1 text "When the fires came out of the deep"
set 11 -1 text "the gates were opened from the inside."
set 12 -1 text "No one now living knows by whom."
set 13 -1 text "Whoever reads this, read it aloud,"
set 14 -1 text "so that the names are spoken once more"
set 15 -1 text "before the stone is worn away."

scenes.name: default
state: set 4 -1 text "Forgive the state of this letter --"
set 5 -1 text "I write it in some haste."
set 6 -1 text "The crypt beneath the church is open."
set 7 -1 text "I went down as far as the second stair"
set 8 -1 text "and heard something moving below it."
set 9 -1 text "Do not send the acolytes after me."
set 10 -1 text "Send word to Varrock instead,"
set 11 -1 text "and have them bring a priest who fights."
set 12 -1 text "If I am not back by the feast day,"
set 13 -1 text "seal the stair and say nothing of it."

scenes.name: default
state: set 4 -1 text "the well on the east road is poisoned."
set 5 -1 text "It was not the drought and not the dead."
set 6 -1 text "Someone did it, and did it carefully."
set 7 -1 text "I have marked the stones I found beside it"
set 8 -1 text "on the back of this page."
set 9 -1 text "Show them to the constable, not the mayor."
set 10 -1 text "I no longer know which of them to trust,"
set 11 -1 text "and one of them already knows my name."
set 12 -1 text "Burn this when you have read it."

scenes.name: default
state: set 6 -1 text "Notice to all tenants of the lower ward"
set 8 -1 text "The east gate will be shut at sundown"
set 9 -1 text "and will not be opened before first light,"
set 10 -1 text "by order of the watch."
set 12 -1 text "Anyone outside the wall after the bell"
set 13 -1 text "must wait at the guardhouse until dawn."
set 15 -1 text "Carts may be left in the outer yard."
set 16 -1 text "The watch is not answerable for them."
set 17 -1 text "Signed, the Captain of the Gate"

scenes.name: default
state: set 6 -1 text "On the making of the third draught"
set 8 -1 text "Take the leaf while it is still green."
set 9 -1 text "Dry it slowly. Heat spoils the colour."
set 10 -1 text "Grind it with the smaller pestle only."
set 12 -1 text "Add water that has boiled and cooled."
set 13 -1 text "Stir until the cloudiness settles out."
set 14 -1 text "It should stand three days in the dark."
set 16 -1 text "If it turns brown it is spoiled."
set 17 -1 text "If it turns clear it was never right."
set 18 -1 text "Begin again and use less of the leaf."

state: type The bank booth in Varrock west does not open when I click it

scenes.name: typed-long
state: type The bank booth in Varrock west does not open when I click it
type It happened on world 302 and again after I logged out and back in, twice.
type Every other booth in the bank works. I was wearing a ring of wealth and
type holding a lobster, and the booth showed no right click options at all when
type I tried to use it, not even Examine. The one next to it was fine and so was
type the deposit box by the door. I have tried it on two worlds now and both times
type the same thing happened, so it is not lag.
type I also cleared my cache and restarted the client before the second try,
type and I checked that the booth is not one of the ones that needs a quest.
type A friend on the same world could use the booth while I stood next to him,
type so it seems to be only my account. It started after the last update today.
type My bank pin is set and I entered it earlier in the session without trouble.
